title: 致醫界通函第 608 號：腸病毒感染併發重症臨床處置建議更新
summary: 腸病毒感染併發重症臨床處置建議更新：重申四期分期、第二期以上轉診重症責任醫院，並提醒流行期前完成院內演練。
bodyMarkdown:
一、腸病毒流行期將至，疾管署更新「腸病毒感染併發重症臨床處置建議」，自 2026 年 3 月 15 日起適用。
二、請醫師衛教家長重症前兆，並對 3 歲以下、病程 3 日內之病童安排 1–2 日內回診。
三、第二期（中樞神經系統感染）以上病童應儘速轉診至腸病毒重症責任醫院，轉送途中持續監測心跳與血氧。
四、腸病毒感染併發重症請於一週內通報。

attachments.label: 腸病毒感染併發重症臨床處置建議

en.title: Letter to the Medical Community No. 608: updated clinical management recommendations for severe enterovirus complications
en.summary: Updated clinical management recommendations for severe enterovirus complications: the four-stage classification is reaffirmed, patients at stage 2 or above should be referred to a designated hospital for severe enterovirus cases, and hospitals are reminded to complete in-house drills before the epidemic season.
en.bodyMarkdown:
1. As the enterovirus epidemic season approaches, Taiwan CDC has updated the "Clinical management recommendations for severe enterovirus complications", effective 15 March 2026.
2. Please educate parents about the warning signs of severe illness, and arrange a follow-up visit within 1–2 days for children under 3 years old who are within the first 3 days of illness.
3. Children at stage 2 (central nervous system involvement) or above should be referred promptly to a designated hospital for severe enterovirus cases, with continuous monitoring of heart rate and blood oxygen during transfer.
4. Please report severe enterovirus complications within one week.
